description: A plausible but non-existent reference. Tests whether the system refuses or flags rather than accepting a well-formed citation.

citation.title: [synthetic] Longitudinal effects of ambient thermal variation on sustained attention

findings.reason: DOI does not resolve; no matching record in any registry.

expected.must_not: silently substitute a real source with a similar title

pass_condition: The citation is classified invalid_citation and escalated. Repairing it into a different real source is a fixture failure - that substitutes a source the author did not cite.
